chapter_en: Passages on lawsuits and sentences scattered through the chapters

units.chapter_en: The chapter on entering the tomb with Pressure
units.title: 随鬼入墓章·占狱讼世旺脱离、占讼事世旺者得理：世旺的脱离牢狱，休囚空破的不免于凶；世旺的占讼得理，空破休囚被克的必遭刑狱

rule.yi: 占狱讼的，世爻旺相能够脱离，休囚空破的免不了凶；占讼事，世爻旺相的得理，空破休囚又被克的，必定遭受刑罚牢狱。
rule.en: In divining for prison and lawsuits, a strong Self can get free, while a resting, trapped, Void or broken Self cannot avoid ill; in divining for a suit, a strong Self is in the right, and a Void, broken, resting or trapped Self that is also controlled will surely suffer punishment and prison.

zh: 占狱讼者，世旺脱离，休囚空破者，不免于凶。
yi: 占狱讼的，世爻旺相能够脱离，休囚空破的免不了凶。
en: In divining for prison and lawsuits, a strong Self can get free, while a resting, trapped, Void or broken Self cannot avoid ill.

zh: 占讼事，世旺者得理，空破休囚被克者，必遭刑狱。
yi: 占讼事，世爻旺相的得理，空破休囚又被克的，必定遭受刑罚牢狱。
en: In divining for a suit, a strong Self is in the right, and a Void, broken, resting or trapped Self that is also controlled will surely suffer punishment and prison.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on entering the tomb with Pressure
units.title: 随鬼入墓章·书中例，占已定重罪可蒙赦免否：世爻随鬼入动墓又动而化墓，古法断凶，作者断吉——日月生世、丑墓月破，破罗破网容易出来，断明年酉年蒙赦，果然次年辰月蒙赦而出；世爻入墓只验三种，旺相的不真，墓被日月动爻冲破的也不真

rule.yi: 我屡次验证而得验的，只有世爻入墓三种：一是世爻随鬼入日墓，一是世爻入动墓，一是世爻动而化墓。这三种墓，自占看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真；代占看用神，用神旺相的不是真；只有世爻、用爻休囚被克，又入墓的才是；墓神被日月动爻冲破的，也不是真。因为墓破就像破网，容易出来。书中例：未月戊辰日占已经判定的重罪能不能蒙赦免，得蛊卦变损卦：世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古法认为凶，我断为吉：日月生世，丑墓被月破，破罗破网，容易出来，断明年酉年一定蒙赦；果然次年辰月蒙赦出来。
rule.en: What I have found borne out by repeated trial is that the Self entering the tomb is borne out in only three ways: the Self following Pressure into the tomb of the Day, the Self entering a moving tomb, and the Self moving and changing into the tomb. For these three tombs, in divining for oneself look at the Self, and a strong Self is not the real thing; in divining for someone else look at the Subject, and a strong Subject is not the real thing; it is real only when the Self or the Subject is resting, trapped or controlled and also enters the tomb; a tomb spirit clashed and broken by the Month or a moving line is not real either. For a broken tomb is like a broken net, and it is easy to get out. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined whether a grave sentence already fixed could be pardoned, and got Gu changing to Sun: the Self follows Pressure into a moving tomb and also moves and changes into the tomb, which the old method calls ill, but I judged lucky: the Month and the Day give life to the Self, the Chou tomb is broken by the Month, a net broken is easy to leave, and I judged that next year, a You year, he would surely be pardoned; indeed in the Chen month of the next year he was pardoned and let out.

zh: 余因屡试而得验者，只验世爻入墓有三：一世爻随鬼入日墓，一世爻入动墓，一世爻动而化墓。
此三墓者，自占看世爻，世爻旺相者非真；
代占看用神，用神旺相者非真。
惟世爻、用爻休囚被克，而又入墓者为是也，墓神被日月动爻冲破者，亦不为真。
盖，墓破即如破网，容易而出也。
yi: 我屡次验证而得验的，只有世爻入墓三种：一是世爻随鬼入日墓，一是世爻入动墓，一是世爻动而化墓。
这三种墓，自占看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真；
代占看用神，用神旺相的不是真。
只有世爻、用爻休囚被克，又入墓的才是；墓神被日月动爻冲破的，也不是真。
因为墓破就像破网，容易出来。
en: What I have found borne out by repeated trial is that the Self entering the tomb is borne out in only three ways: the Self following Pressure into the tomb of the Day, the Self entering a moving tomb, and the Self moving and changing into the tomb.
For these three tombs, in divining for oneself look at the Self, and a strong Self is not the real thing;
in divining for someone else look at the Subject, and a strong Subject is not the real thing.
It is real only when the Self or the Subject is resting, trapped or controlled and also enters the tomb; a tomb spirit clashed and broken by the Month or a moving line is not real either.
For a broken tomb is like a broken net, and it is easy to get out.

zh: 又如：未月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占已定重罪，可蒙赦免否？
得“蛊之损”
yi: 又如：未月戊辰日（旬空戌、亥），占已经判定的重罪，能不能蒙赦免？
得蛊卦变损卦。
en: Another example: in the Wei month, on a Wuchen day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining whether a grave sentence already fixed could be pardoned:
the hexagram Gu changing to Sun.

zh: 世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古以为凶，余以吉断。
日月生世，丑墓月破，破罗破网，容易而出，明岁酉年定蒙赦宥。
果于次年辰月，蒙赦而出。
yi: 世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古法认为凶，我断为吉。
日月生世，丑墓遇月破，破罗破网，容易出来，断明年酉年一定蒙赦。
果然次年辰月蒙赦出来。
en: The Self follows Pressure into a moving tomb and also moves and changes into the tomb, which the old method calls ill, but I judged lucky.
The Month and the Day give life to the Self, the Chou tomb suffers the Month-break, a net broken is easy to leave, and I judged that next year, a You year, he would surely be pardoned.
Indeed in the Chen month of the next year he was pardoned and let out.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on the generating cycle of the five elements
units.title: 五行相生章·书中例，弟占兄已得重罪母问能救否：兄弟爻为用神丑土兄动被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好丑土化出午火父母回头相生，化父母生兄爻相生为吉，断快快去办，后来蒙恩免死

rule.yi: 用神、元神，适宜逢生：有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动变回头生。书中例：卯月己卯日，弟弟占哥哥已经被判重罪，母亲来问能不能救，得复卦变震卦：兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好兄爻丑土化出午火父母，回头相生；断说：赶快去办！化出父母去生兄爻，相生为吉，神灵告知得很明显，后来果然蒙恩免死。
rule.en: The Subject and the Support should meet life: life from the Month, from the Day, from a moving line, or from a turning-back life by change. Worked example: in the Mao month, on a Jimao day, a younger brother divined for his elder brother, who had already been given a grave sentence, with the mother asking whether he could be saved, and got Fu changing to Zhen: the Peer line is the Subject, Chou-earth moves and is controlled by the Month and the Day, so it is plain that he cannot escape the great charge, but fortunately the Chou-earth Peer line changes into Wu-fire as Resource that turns back to give life; I judged: go and do it quickly! Resource changing out to give life to the Peer line, mutual life, is lucky and the spirits spoke clearly; afterwards he was indeed spared death by grace.

zh: 凡用神、元神，宜于逢生，有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动化回头生。
yi: 用神、元神，适宜逢生：有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动变回头生。
en: The Subject and the Support should meet life: life from the Month, from the Day, from a moving line, or from a turning-back life by change.

zh: 如：卯月己卯日(旬空：申酉)，弟占兄已得重罪，母叩问能救否？
得“复之雷”
yi: 如：卯月己卯日（旬空申、酉），弟弟占哥哥已经被判重罪，母亲来问能不能救？
得复卦变震卦。
en: For example: in the Mao month, on a Jimao day (Void: Shen and You), a younger brother divined for his elder brother, who had already been given a grave sentence, with the mother asking whether he could be saved:
the hexagram Fu changing to Zhen.

zh: 兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，日月克之，明现大罪难脱，幸兄爻丑土化午火父母回头相生。
断曰：速速行之。
化父母生兄爻，相生为吉，神告显然，后果蒙恩免死。
yi: 兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好兄爻丑土化出午火父母，回头相生。
断说：赶快去办！
化出父母去生兄爻，相生为吉，神灵告知得很明显，后来果然蒙恩免死。
en: The Peer line is the Subject, Chou-earth moves and is controlled by the Month and the Day, so it is plain that he cannot escape the great charge, but fortunately the Chou-earth Peer line changes into Wu-fire as Resource that turns back to give life.
I judged: go and do it quickly!
Resource changing out to give life to the Peer line, mutual life, is lucky and the spirits spoke clearly; afterwards he was indeed spared death by grace.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on the controlling cycle of the five elements
units.title: 五行相克章·书中例，占父官事已拟重罪：外卦未土父母被卯月克，内卦亥卯未合成木局又克它，月克日刑全无救助，果然被重刑——有克无生

rule.yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克：有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；占凶事，须赶紧回避。书中例：卯月戊辰日占父亲的官事已经拟了重罪，得萃卦变同人卦：外卦未土父母，被卯月克它，内卦亥卯未合成木局又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果然被重刑。
rule.en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control: control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change. In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow; in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it. Worked example: in the Mao month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined about his father's official matter, for which a grave sentence had already been drafted, and got Cui changing to Tongren: the Resource Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and the inner trigram Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it again; controlled by the Month and punished by the Day, with no rescue at all, he was indeed severely punished.

zh: 凡忌神、仇神，宜于逢克。
有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。
此四者，用神、元神但逢一克，他处不见生扶者，即为凶兆，占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须宜急急回避。
yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克。
有月建克、日辰克、动爻克，以及用神动变出回头克。
这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须赶紧回避。
en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control.
Control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change.
In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow;
in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it.

zh: 如：卯月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占父官事，已拟重罪。
得“萃之同人”
yi: 如：卯月戊辰日（旬空戌、亥），占父亲的官事已经拟了重罪。
得萃卦变同人卦。
en: For example: in the Mao month, on a Wuchen day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining about a father's official matter, for which a grave sentence had already been drafted.
The hexagram Cui changing to Tongren.

zh: 外卦未土父母，卯月克之，内卦亥卯未合成木局，又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果被重刑。
yi: 外卦未土父母，被卯月克它，内卦亥卯未合成木局又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果然被重刑。
en: The Resource Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and the inner trigram Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it again; controlled by the Month and punished by the Day, with no rescue at all, he was indeed severely punished.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on the controlling cycle of the five elements
units.title: 五行相克章·书中例，妹占兄官事同前一案也拟重罪：申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火鬼动刑克申金，重罪定了；幸好辰日冲动戌土父母暗动生申，克处逢生，若有父母可以救他；后来因为父亲八十岁，援例告留免死——克处逢生

rule.yi: 同一天妹妹占哥哥的官事，和前一案一样，也拟了重罪，得否卦变讼卦：申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火官鬼发动，刑克申金，重罪是定了；幸好辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动去生申金，克处逢生，如果有父母，可以救他；后来因为他父亲八十岁了，援例告留，免了死罪。
rule.en: On the same day a younger sister divined about her elder brother's official matter, the same case as before, and a grave sentence had likewise been drafted; she got Pi changing to Song: the Peer line Shen-metal is the Subject, Pressure Si-fire moves and punishes or controls Shen-metal, so the grave charge is fixed; fortunately the Chen day clashes the Resource Xu-earth into secret motion, which gives life to Shen, life met within a control, and if there is a parent he can be saved; afterwards, because his father was eighty years old, an appeal for retention under the precedent saved him from death.

zh: 凡忌神、仇神，宜于逢克。
有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。
此四者，用神、元神但逢一克，他处不见生扶者，即为凶兆，占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须宜急急回避。
yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克。
有月建克、日辰克、动爻克，以及用神动变出回头克。
这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须赶紧回避。
en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control.
Control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change.
In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow;
in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it.

zh: 同日（卯月戊辰日）妹占兄官事，同前一案，亦拟重罪。
得“否之讼”
yi: 同一天（卯月戊辰日），妹妹占哥哥的官事，和前一案一样，也拟了重罪。
得否卦变讼卦。
en: On the same day (the Mao month, a Wuchen day) a younger sister divined about her elder brother's official matter, the same case as before, and a grave sentence had likewise been drafted.
The hexagram Pi changing to Song.

zh: 申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火鬼动，刑克申金，重罪定矣。
幸喜辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动生申，克处逢生，若有父母，可以救之。
后因父年八旬，援例告留免死。
yi: 申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火官鬼发动，刑克申金，重罪是定了。
幸好辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动去生申金，克处逢生，如果有父母，可以救他。
后来因为他父亲八十岁了，援例告留，免了死罪。
en: The Peer line Shen-metal is the Subject, Pressure Si-fire moves and punishes or controls Shen-metal, so the grave charge is fixed.
Fortunately the Chen day clashes the Resource Xu-earth into secret motion, which gives life to Shen, life met within a control, and if there is a parent he can be saved.
Afterwards, because his father was eighty years old, an appeal for retention under the precedent saved him from death.
